links.name: Fee arrangements disproportionate to services or paid by third parties
links.ctx: Legal or arbitration fees that are very high, success-based without any contest, or paid by a party outside the matter.

links.name: Fee arrangements disproportionate to services or paid by third parties
links.ctx: Agent or intermediary commissions on transfers are large relative to the service, split across several parties, or paid by someone other than the club or player.
